behavior_contract.auto: Omitted/auto project_type selects a fixed indexing preset at registration from eligible manifest/source paths. Explicit profiles and existing registrations remain unchanged. Mixed ecosystems use general coverage.
behavior_contract.metadata: Evidence derived from held persisted source-file revisions, including empty files; no stale graph metadata or live disk inference. Scope is the chosen preset and ignore rules, not all files on disk or compiler/build semantics.
behavior_contract.discovery: Union across all registered source projects, intersected with configured full/core surface. No source project means no legacy tools; unknown legacy/unavailable source coverage conservatively preserves specialized discovery. Explicit WebForms profiles retain access. General core dependencies remain visible.
